column1: # Our adjudications of the rows that the dev-time checker (LemmInflect, a pip tool; nothing ships from it) disagrees with.
# Columns: spelling, lemma, part-of-speech letter, verdict (valid or invalid), note naming OUR source that decides the row, optional features.
# The verdict is ours: it rests on OEWN, AGID, the Moby word list and our lists and rules, never on the checker. The checker's own forms are not recorded here.
# A row the checker disagrees with and that is not listed stays an error. A row the checker accepts is valid whatever is listed.
# The rows that our sources showed wrong are not listed: they were corrected in the generator or in corpus/lexicon/form-corrections.tsv.
# Adjudicated for the samples of seeds 20240601, 99, 7, 2025 and 31337 with 300 rows per stratum.
